meta.units: px on a 1920x1080 canvas. 1px = 9525 EMU. Font sizes: px = pt * 1920/1440 (= pt*4/3). letterSpacingPx from spc (1/100 pt).
notes: Group transforms (off/ext/chOff/chExt, Canva uses a uniform 0.75 child scale) are resolved: all x/y/w/h are absolute slide px.
Invisible elements were omitted: Canva text-frame placeholders (blipFill image2.jpeg with alphaModFix amt=0) and empty text boxes.
Elements are listed in z-order (first = bottom). "parent" = id of the containing group.

Logo images: image.src is ready to use at the frame box (PNG pre-cropped to the frame per fillRect; SVG preferred when the PPTX had an asvg:svgBlip). No duotone/grayscale/alpha/clrChange effects exist on any logo; they are pre-coloured dark slate (#29313F).
cornerRadiiPx = [rx, ry] per corner, measured from the custGeom path; Canva corners are often elliptical (rx != ry) because shapes were stretched.

No element in the deck is rotated or flipped (rotation omitted); no shadows/effects; no cap="all" attributes (uppercase text is literally typed in caps); all line spacing is exact (spcPts) -> lineHeightPx; text insets are 0 on every Canva text box.
Stroke widths are the raw <a:ln w> (not scaled by the group transform, as PowerPoint renders them).

fonts.Now 1: Now Regular (Alfredo Marco Pradil, OFL) -> fonts/Now-Regular.otf
fonts.Now 2: same font as Now 1 (Canva renamed copy) -> fonts/Now-Regular.otf
